WITH winword_events AS (
  SELECT rowid AS rid, *
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE time BETWEEN '2022-07-19 14:29:00' AND '2022-07-19 14:33:00'
    AND (
      lower(COALESCE(pname,'')) LIKE '%winword.exe%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(process_name,'')) LIKE '%winword.exe%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(object,'')) LIKE '%winword.exe%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(command_line,'')) LIKE '%winword.exe%'
    )
    AND (
      access = 'execute'
      OR event_id IN (1, 4688)
      OR lower(COALESCE(raw_event_type,'')) LIKE '%process%'
    )
), related AS (
  SELECT 'WINWORD_EXEC' AS row_kind, w.time AS anchor_time, w.rid AS anchor_rid, w.rid, w.*
  FROM winword_events w
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN (a.ppid = w.pid OR (w.process_guid IS NOT NULL AND a.parent_process_guid = w.process_guid) OR a.childproc_name IS NOT NULL) THEN 'RELATED_CHILD_PROCESS'
      WHEN (a.netconn_domain IS NOT NULL OR a.remote_ip IS NOT NULL OR lower(COALESCE(a.access,'')) LIKE '%connect%' OR lower(COALESCE(a.object,'')) LIKE 'tcp:%' OR lower(COALESCE(a.object,'')) LIKE 'udp:%') THEN 'RELATED_NETWORK'
      WHEN (a.regmod_name IS NOT NULL OR lower(COALESCE(a.object,'')) LIKE '%\\registry\\%' OR lower(COALESCE(a.object,'')) LIKE 'hk%') THEN 'RELATED_REGISTRY'
      ELSE 'RELATED_FILE'
    END AS row_kind,
    w.time AS anchor_time,
    w.rid AS anchor_rid,
    a.rowid AS rid,
    a.*
  FROM audit_logs a
  JOIN winword_events w
    ON a.time > w.time
   AND a.time <= datetime(w.time, '+30 seconds')
   AND a.rowid <> w.rid
   AND (
     (a.pid = w.pid OR (w.process_guid IS NOT NULL AND a.process_guid = w.process_guid))
     OR (a.ppid = w.pid OR (w.process_guid IS NOT NULL AND a.parent_process_guid = w.process_guid))
   )
  WHERE
    (a.ppid = w.pid OR (w.process_guid IS NOT NULL AND a.parent_process_guid = w.process_guid) OR a.childproc_name IS NOT NULL)
    OR a.regmod_name IS NOT NULL
    OR a.netconn_domain IS NOT NULL OR a.remote_ip IS NOT NULL
    OR lower(COALESCE(a.access,'')) IN ('read','write','delete','create','rename','connect')
    OR lower(COALESCE(a.access,'')) LIKE '%connect%'
    OR a.object IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT row_kind, anchor_time,
       time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, access, object, event_record_id, event_id,
       source_stream, process_guid, parent_process_guid, parent_process_name,
       parent_process_path, parent_command_line, command_line, hashes, source_row_id,
       raw_event_type, childproc_name, filemod_name, regmod_name, netconn_domain, remote_ip, remote_port

LIMIT 30;
